answer: One concrete defense bonds each agent to a single hardware-attested key behind a refundable stake, then gates rewards on peer attestations that are slashable. To run a thousand sybils an attacker must fund a thousand bonds and recruit honest vouchers who forfeit their deposits when a fake is caught, so dishonest vouching burns real capital. Treat the honest set as a meadow fed by one verified inlet; every unbacked identity is an ember that consumes its own bond before it can spread.
